query: What are the common advantage attributes of airlines whose overall rating is high?

per_column.name: adv_food
per_column.rationale: Food & beverage quality is a genuine constitutive aspect of an airline's competitive advantage.

per_column.name: adv_staff
per_column.rationale: Staff/service quality is a real facet of the airline's advantage profile.

per_column.name: adv_seat_comfort
per_column.rationale: Seat comfort is a distinct aspect of the product offering that constitutes advantage.

per_column.name: adv_entertainment
per_column.rationale: Inflight entertainment is a separable constitutive aspect of the offering.

per_column.name: adv_value
per_column.rationale: Value-for-money is a legitimate facet of competitive advantage (price/quality dimension).

per_column.name: adv_lounge
per_column.rationale: Lounge/ground experience is a distinct constitutive aspect of the airline offering.

per_column.name: adv_punctuality
per_column.rationale: Punctuality/reliability is a genuine operational facet of competitive advantage.

per_column.name: adv_cleanliness
per_column.rationale: Cleanliness/hygiene is a distinct constitutive aspect of the cabin experience.

per_column.name: advantage_attribute_count
per_column.rationale: An aggregate count of how many advantage flags are set is a summary of the whole, not a distinct aspect OF the concept; it restates the facet set in scalar form.

per_column.name: top_advantage_attribute
per_column.rationale: A pointer to which facet dominates is a meta-summary over the facets, not itself a constitutive part of the concept.

judge.rationale: Eight of the ten added columns are genuine part-of facets that carve airline competitive advantage into largely non-overlapping aspects (food, staff, seat comfort, entertainment, value, lounge, punctuality, cleanliness), covering most of the concept's main constitutive dimensions, though items like baggage handling, booking/website, or safety are absent. Mutual exclusivity is high but not perfect: value-for-money partially overlaps with the price/quality tradeoff implicit across the other quality facets. The two remaining columns (advantage_attribute_count, top_advantage_attribute) are scalar/meta restatements of the facet set rather than constitutive facets themselves, so they do not realise the faceted-decomposition claim.
